# OSHA Confined Space Training: Awareness, Entrant/Attendant, Supervisor & Competent Person

> OSHA Confined Space Training: 4 self-paced online courses from $49.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## Courses

- [OSHA Confined Space Awareness Training](https://confined-space.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-100): $49.99 per person, 3 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 36 months. In accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1926 Subpart AA. Enroll: https://confined-space.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=100.
